product_description_excerpt: We're making a platform that lets people automate repetitive processes with plain language. Say you want a reminder whenever a coworker emails you. Instead of using prebuilt blocks or writing code, just tell DryMerge "Whenever John sends me an email, shoot me a slack message reminding me to respond" and watch it happen.
